dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Huh, why do you look so disinterested? Is my information out of date?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Well, I can't help it. Inazuma's been locked down for so long. I had to ask around a lot to find all this intel, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Of course, it's all small beans compared to what a person who's seen the world might know, but among the people of Watatsumi Island, such news is in rather high demand.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Guess I should do business with locals instead, huh...
